nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.purpose: The cloud heart: accounts, database, Edge Functions, secret vault and timers; the licence validator and the Store signer run here.
nodes.cost: Free plan (0 EUR); upgrade to Pro (25 USD/month) only if limits bite
nodes.account: Supabase org timenet-cell's Org (Free), project bxxscrkhcqdxgdhiuuoa, region eu-west-1
secrets: Vault: fork_signer_fee_payer, fork_signer_tree_delegate, fork_signer_collection_delegate, fork_signer_freeze_delegate, fork_signer_lease_issuer, fork_signer_escrow, fork_signer_devnet_authority
nodes.limits: Project pauses after 7 days without activity (the 30 s signer timer keeps it awake); free database and storage caps; a pause would stop sign-in, store and signer at once

nodes.label: Resend
nodes.purpose: Sends all Supabase Auth emails (sign-up, magic link, reset) and beta invites from noreply@forkgate.io via smtp.resend.com:465.
nodes.cost: Free plan (0 EUR) for the beta
nodes.account: Resend account fragosomail; domain forkgate.io Verified (3 Nov 2026), region Ireland eu-west-1
secrets: API key "supabase" (sending access, forkgate.io), stored only in Supabase Auth custom SMTP
nodes.limits: 3,000 emails/month and 100/day on the free plan; the sending domain needs DNS records (SPF, DKIM) Setup 2-3 Nov: DNS records added at Spaceship (DKIM, send/rsend CNAME, DMARC); Supabase custom SMTP still to be set by the owner.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.purpose: Takes payments for licences and pays artists out; money is held back to cover disputes.
nodes.cost: No monthly fee; per-sale fee (about 1.5% + 0.25 EUR in Europe) and Connect payout fees, so not zero-cost once sales start
nodes.account: unknown (test mode only, switch is off)
used_by: Edge Functions store_checkout, stripe_webhook, connect_onboard, store_refund
nodes.limits: Test mode only; going live needs business verification and a payout bank account; disputes can claw money back for months

nodes.label: Solana devnet
nodes.purpose: Beta licence seals: every licence is recorded on a practice blockchain, free to test the real code.
nodes.account: unknown (devnet authority wallet; its key is disposable)
nodes.limits: Public devnet RPC is rate-limited and can be reset; the faucet caps airdrops

nodes.label: Solana mainnet
nodes.purpose: Real licence seals from alpha: the permanent public record that a licence exists.
nodes.cost: Not zero-cost: about 0.02 SOL (about 3 USD) covers years of seals, plus the fee-payer balance and a 0.3 SOL registry
nodes.account: unknown (multisig owner wallet to be created)
secrets: database flag signer_mainnet_enabled (off) and a signer_mainnet_approval row
nodes.limits: Blocked by code until the owner signs a separate decision; the fee payer is the only hot key that can lose money (balance is capped)

nodes.label: Helius RPC
nodes.purpose: A reliable line into the blockchain that can also list a wallet's licences (DAS).
nodes.cost: Free plan (0 EUR) covers the beta; paid tiers from about 49 USD/month if traffic grows
nodes.limits: Free plan has monthly request credits and a requests-per-second cap; the public Solana RPC has no DAS

nodes.label: GitHub Pages
nodes.purpose: Hosts forkgate.io: landing, beta signup, verify pages, /connect and this admin.
nodes.limits: Soft limits: 1 GB site, 100 GB/month traffic; static files only; the repository is public, so nothing secret may be committed

nodes.label: GitHub Actions
nodes.purpose: A scheduled job that touches Supabase so it never pauses from idleness.
secrets: planned: repository secret for the Supabase URL and anon key (names to be set)
nodes.limits: No workflow is committed in the site repository yet; scheduled workflows are disabled after 60 days without commits

nodes.label: GitHub release feeds
nodes.purpose: Delivers app installers and signed automatic updates to testers.
nodes.limits: Feed repositories fork-studio-releases, fork-music-releases, fork-labels-releases, fork-manager-releases are still to create; release asset size limit 2 GB per file

nodes.label: Apple Developer Program
nodes.purpose: Lets the apps open on other computers without the security warning (signing and notarisation).
nodes.cost: Not zero-cost: 99 EUR/year, postponed to after the beta
nodes.limits: Until then testers open the apps with a one-time right-click, and builds use the local Fork Studio Dev certificate

nodes.label: VPS relay
nodes.purpose: A small always-on server that would help two computers behind strict routers reach each other.
nodes.cost: Not used in beta (a VPS would be roughly 4-6 EUR/month)
nodes.limits: Direct connections and hole punching already work; revisit if testers on strict networks cannot connect

nodes.label: Public STUN servers
nodes.purpose: Lets the phone and the computer find each other for the direct tunnel.
nodes.limits: No uptime promise; STUN only helps discover addresses, no TURN relay is deployed, so strict networks can fail

nodes.label: jsDelivr CDN
nodes.purpose: Serves the Supabase browser library to the site, admin and /connect.
nodes.limits: Pinned to supabase-js 2.45.4; if the CDN is down those pages cannot sign in

nodes.label: forkgate.io domain
nodes.purpose: The public address of the site and of every link in the apps.
nodes.cost: Not zero-cost: yearly domain renewal (price and renewal date not recorded)
nodes.account: Spaceship (registrar and DNS), domain forkgate.io, expires 2027-10-15
secrets: none in the repo (registrar login and DNS)
nodes.limits: If the domain lapses, the site, verify links and the PWA all break; keep auto-renew on

nodes.label: npm and crates.io
nodes.purpose: Download the open-source building blocks when the apps are built.
nodes.limits: Build-time only; vendored copies live in the monorepo vendor folder

nodes.label: Meta Graph API
nodes.purpose: Posts videos and photos to Instagram and Facebook for the artist.
nodes.account: unknown (Meta developer app and the artist's own Instagram/Facebook pages)
secrets: access tokens kept locally by Fork Manager; names not in the repo
nodes.limits: Needs a public media URL, so it depends on the tunnel chain; Meta app review limits who can use it

nodes.label: SoundCloud API
nodes.purpose: Uploads and reads releases on the label's SoundCloud account.
nodes.cost: Free API (needs the account's own plan for uploads)
secrets: SoundCloud client id and secret, kept locally by Fork Labels
nodes.limits: API access by approval; per-app request limits

nodes.label: Google (Gmail, YouTube)
nodes.purpose: Sends label emails and publishes to YouTube with the artist's own Google account.
nodes.account: unknown (Google Cloud project and the artist's own account)
nodes.limits: Gmail daily sending cap; YouTube Data API daily quota; OAuth consent screen in testing mode expires tokens after 7 days

nodes.label: Tunnel providers
nodes.purpose: Give Fork Manager a temporary public address so Instagram can fetch a video.
nodes.cost: Free (Tailscale Funnel, Cloudflare quick tunnel, Pinggy, Serveo)
nodes.limits: Fallback chain, in order: Tailscale Funnel, Cloudflare, Pinggy, Serveo; the last two were unreliable in tests
